lines.en: I measure the ground step by step.
I walk slowly and steadily.
My pale body pushes through the grass.
I drag a soft foot forward.
The ground I cross feels tacky.
I walk in a circle.
My body pulses faintly.
I shift half a block your way.
My shadow clings to the ground.

lines.zh: 我一路留下浅浅的水痕
lines.en: A shallow wet trail follows me.
I stop and turn half about.
I drift to the middle of the clearing.

lines.zh: 我每一步都在试着重量
lines.en: Each step tests my own weight.
I go around the stone and keep walking.
I haul my shadow along.
The grass springs back after I pass.
I stand, faintly heaving.
I am feeling out every wound.
My surface closes over slowly.
I am still as a stone.
I am waiting for the next blow.
I exhale a small cloudy breath.
My tendrils hang down.
I am counting my own pulses.
I sway my body slowly.
I tilt up toward the light.
I neither flinch nor shift.
My colour has faded a little.
I listen to everything around.
I shift my weight to the other side.
My shadow moves; I do not.
I am slowly recovering.
I turn to you without feeling.

lines.zh: 你打在我身上的都记着
lines.en: I remember every hit you land.
I do not dodge; I only stand.
Your strength is not enough.
Ripples cross my surface.
I know what you are holding.
A few more tries will not matter.
You'll never chew through my health pool.
Rest if you are tired.
My body waits for your strike.
You cannot break through me.
I will not strike back.

lines.zh: 我记下了这一下的数值
lines.en: I have logged that value.
My surface has a dent.
The wound is closing slowly.
I rock my body.
That one hit a hard spot.
My face shows nothing.
The number keeps climbing.
I straighten up again.
I record it in my body.
The damage numbers haven't maxed out yet.
You hold that up for me to see.
I lean over bit by bit.
I have no need to eat.
I sniff it; nothing happens.
That is not in my routine.
I move around it.
I don't eat debug props.

lines.zh: 我的注意力回到你身上
lines.en: My attention returns to you.
Hold it as long as you like.
No ripple crosses my surface.

lines.zh: 一千万血的测试品，用不上。
lines.en: A million-HP test dummy, no use to me.
I touch it once.
I settle slowly over it.
I rear up toward you.
I simply stand.
Try something else.
You bump me and I do not move.
My body swallows the force.

lines.zh: 你被弹开了半步，我血条还没动。
lines.en: You bounced half a step; my health bar has not moved.
I shift slightly aside.
Hitting me is like hitting wet clay.
Ripples spread over me.
I sink a little.
You slip along my flank.
I do not even twitch.
Such a bump is nothing.
Another body slides up.
We press together.
Two ripples merge into one.
We pulse at the same time.
It is a little shorter than I.
Our shadows overlap.
We turn together.
We need no sound between us.
It stops half a block away.
We stand still together.
I curl a tendril around it.
I draw it into my body.
I lift it on a tendril.

lines.zh: 一百万点血，就是拿来挨打的。
lines.en: A million hit points, all for taking hits.
I crush it.
I nudge it to your feet.
It sinks into my surface.
I slowly push it back out.
I weigh it.
I drop it at my feet.
I square my body up.
My surface begins to harden.
I am measuring your range.
I lift one limb slowly.

lines.zh: 你把注意力放我身上就行
lines.en: Just keep your attention on me.
I move faster than before.
I am ready for the next hit.
My surface pulls tight.
I begin logging your attacks.
I will be more careful this round.
I watch where you strike.

lines.zh: 我有一百万点血，随你打。
lines.en: A million health; hit me all you like.
I am in no hurry to answer.

lines.zh: 我在算你下一击的力道
lines.en: I am gauging your next blow.
You drop a shoulder before each swing.
I turn my body slightly.
I wait for your strength to run out.
You are breathing faster now.
I edge toward you.
I do not plan to keep taking hits.

lines.zh: 我伸出肢体推了你一下
lines.en: I push you with a limb.
My body slams into you.
I lash out a tendril.
That one landed heavier.
I press down on your foot.
I squeeze in from the side.
My movement comes with a wet sound.
You are shoved back two steps.
I withdraw; my surface still ripples.
I do not pursue.
I swell up slowly from the ground.
First I test my movement.
The ground around me turns damp.
I rise, a little taller than a person.
There is a smell of the sea.
I have settled onto this ground.
A million points. Hit away.
I turn to face you.
My shadow spreads wide.
I begin recording this contact.

lines.zh: 火在表面烧出一层干壳
lines.en: Fire dries a crust on my surface.
I fall from a height.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，不觉得难受
lines.en: I soak in water without discomfort.
The blast tears my body open.
Something sticks in my body.
Magic scorches my surface.
I am empty and still standing.
Lightning bursts my surface open.
The void drags me down.
